Black stone arrow tips are items dropped by bosses in The Shadow Reef.

sc: A commander skirt is an item that can be purchased from Stanley Limelight Traders for 30 thaler.

The commander skirt was formerly purchased from Commander Loman on the of the Mobilising Armies office tower by spending 89,600 reward points earned from playing the minigame alongside having a 100+ rank within the minigame.
A Constitution XP lamp is awarded when defeating the Goblin Champion.
Cosy Earmuffs (Saradomin) Token (Untradeable) is an item that can be obtained from Blue Christmas Presents from the 2024 Christmas event onward.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Cosy Earmuffs (Saradomin) cosmetic override, destroying the token in the process.
Players obtain a whole set from the While Guthix Sleeps quest.
Players can also get it as a drop from Dagon'hai Monks or trade from other players.
The Deathcon t-shirt is a reward from the seasonal quest Deathcon II.

It is obtained by upgrading a tier 70 variant with 2 Hermodic plates, 2 pieces of greater ensouled cloth, 1 spool of greater ensouled thread, and 25 miasma runes after the completion of Kili's Knowledge VI (power).

Dervish shoes (blue, male).x: The blue dervish shoes are part of the dervish outfit item set. They give no bonuses and are a cosmetic item.

Dervish shoes (blue-gold).x: The blue-gold dervish shoes are part of the dervish outfit item set. They give no bonuses and are a cosmetic item.

sc: It is received by talking to the clay golem, who is located in the remains of the ruined city of Uzer.
The amulet's teleport is virtually identical to the Tornado emote purchased from the Loyalty Programme Shop, with the only difference being the tornado itself is changed from brown to tan.
Diamond cape is a back slot cosmetic override that can be won from the Vault of Riches promotion on Treasure Hunter.

Driftwood is found by searching the ruined boat in the south-east corner of the Penguin Hunting Area, and is used as a substitute for logs in hunting due to the lack of trees on the Iceberg; it can not be burned like logs.
Up to 4 driftwood pieces may also be found inside Nyriki's crate.
Equuis Book is an off-hand magic weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 2 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 13 of Zodiyak Track.
It is created by using an extended super antifire on a potion flask.

sc: Fitted Springtime Hat (Blooming) is a head slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked through the Egg Hunt promotion from Treasure Hunter.
The Death Lotus Glaive is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that could formerly be purchased for 800 oddments from the Oddments Store.
It was originally available from the Death Lotus Training promotion from Treasure Hunter by completing the death lotus training scroll three times and claiming the glaive from the prestige interface.

Goebie Warpaint (Blue) Bottom.x: The Goebie Warpaint (Blue) Bottom is a legs slot cosmetic override that can be obtained by completing Call of the Ancestors.

sc: Golden off-hand chaotic longsword is an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased alongside its main hand variant for 1 golden cosmetic token from the Golden Goods shop.
The Greater Flurry ability codex is dropped by Astellarn in the Dragonkin Laboratory.

It is obtained from the powder barrel next to the cannon that must be fired at the enemy pirates, after which it must be put into the cannon, followed by several other items, to fire the cannon and blast the enemies away.
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.
Honeycomb shards are a reward item from the beekeeping activity at Blooming Burrow, introduced with the 2025 Easter event.
The Prime Gaming and small knowledge bombs are currently the only ones that can be obtained.
It is unknown if this item is scrapped or if it may become obtainable soon.
Ice coolers can be bought from any Slayer master.
Inspiration was a tier 2 aura available as part of the Members Loyalty Programme and could be purchased from Xuan in Burthorpe, for 23,000 Loyalty Points.
The intricate decorative platebody is a platebody that can be bought as a reward from Lanthus for 800 gold Castle wars tickets and requires a defence level of 60 to wear.
They can be made by using 9 iron ore on the smelter.
Lemon chunks is an item that can be made by right clicking a lemon and selecting "Slice".
While the hood is bought with the skillcape, it is not needed to perform the emote associated with it; the skillcape is the only essential item.
The marmaros plateskirt is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.
Menaphite Ancient is a cosmetic override set that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
It could originally be unlocked with the 2016 Premier Club package.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 mithril bars, requiring 800 progress to complete, granting a total of 240 Smithing experience.
When dropped by a monster, it will be treated like tiny spiky mithril salvage by the spring cleaner.
Mod Dolan's rubber duck is an Easter egg item for players obtainable as a "drop".
It has a 1/10,000 chance of being obtained from digging for compost or supercompost using the Fertiliser ability of legendary pets.
Moonlight halo is an aura slot cosmetic override that is unlocked through the Academy of Skillers promotion from Treasure Hunter, or by redeeming a Moonlight Enchanter Robes token.
Nasturtium seeds can be bought from the Vinesweeper minigame for 10 points each or pickpocketed from farmers.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 8 necronium bars and a necronium pickaxe + 2, requiring 1,920 progress to complete, granting a total of 4,000 Smithing experience.
An oak sapling is obtained by planting an acorn in a plant pot filled with soil, then using a watering can on the plant pot.
Onyx Skin is a skin colour that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
Once the benefit is obtained, it permanently unlocks the ability to change the player character's skin colour to onyx.

Order of Dis hood.x: The Order of Dis hood is a head slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by completing Twilight of the Gods. It is part of the Order of Dis robes.

tx: Speak to Juna to unlock the ability to make the bowl. Use a lit sapphire lantern on one of the light creatures to pass across the chasm and mine one of the magic stone rocks. Craft the larger rock into an ornate stone bowl. After making the bowl, go east and jump across the gap, then go north to speak to Juna. She will keep the bowl for you to use to collect the tears.
sc: An ornate bowl is a reward that can be obtained after the completion of the Tears of Guthix quest.
It can be made by using a chisel on a larger rock, requiring 80 Mining and 80 Crafting.

tx: The recipe for overload salve can be found inside Daemonheim while training Dungeoneering, or purchased from Daemonheim Rewards after asking Lady Meilyr for details. After finding the unreadable page, purchasing the recipe for coins at the Recipe Shop will permanently unlock the ability to mix the potion. The shop is operated by Lady Meilyr or any harmony pillar farmer in the Meilyr district of Prifddinas.

The ingredients of an overload salve can be combined into a stackable unfinished potion by Granny Rowan once the tier 3 Botanist's Workbench has been constructed in Fort Forinthry. Unfinished overload salves can then be finished at the workbench for the usual experience. The usual potion duplication bonuses apply, but ingredient-saving bonuses do not.
sc: The overload salve is a combination potion that can be created by the player at level 97 Herblore after unlocking the recipe.
It is created by combining a overload (4), prayer renewal (4), prayer potion (4), super antifire (4), antifire (4) and super antipoison (4) in a crystal flask, granting 500 experience.
A pot of wheat is made by using some wheat on an empty pot.
Praetorian's log page 5 can be obtained by excavating at the Kharid-et Dig Site at the ancient magick munitions, praetorian remains, and war table debris excavation hotspots.

The following quantities of wood spirits must be used to create this item from the ensouled moonstone. A dwarven chainaxe in resource mode may be used to speed this up at the cost of experience. This process will consume the wood spirit, but not award any logs. Wood spirits stored within a wood box can be used.
The progress is awarded when the wood spirit is consumed, so Sana's fyrtorch and the Seer's Headband can provide multiple levels of progress at once when they provide extra logs. The Fortune perk does not consume extra wood spirits, so does not provide extra progress.
The ensouled moonstone can also be inspected at any point to see the progress towards creating this item.

sc: The turkey hat is a vanity item that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.

It could previously be obtained by activating a 90 day RuneScape membership game card from Target (US) or GAME (UK) stores and redeem it between 18 November and 8 December 2011, or purchase the gold premier club between 20 December 2012 and 31 January 2013.

They can also be bought from farmers for 1 coin each.

This potion can be made into a weapon poison+++ flask by using at least six doses of it with a potion flask.
